en: The Dhāraṇī of the Bodhisattva Sūryaprabha and the Bodhisattva Candraprabha.
This mantra was spoken by the Bodhisattva Sūryaprabha from the Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva’s Mahākaruṇā-citta-dhāraṇī Sūtra for those who uphold the Mahākaruṇā-citta-dhāraṇī, as a great divine spell.
Mantra. May it protect them.

Namo buddhāya guṇamaye (1) | Namo dharmāya mahāte (2) | Namo saṃghāya tathāgate (3) | Tīrṇe pūrṇe (4) | Saṃbuddhadharmadhāraṇa namaḥ (5) | Svāhā (6). By reciting this mantra, all sins are extinguished.
It can also ward off demons and eliminate celestial calamities.
If one recites this mantra once and prostrates to the Buddha once,
and thus recites the mantra and prostrates to the Buddha three times each day;
In future lives, wherever they receive a body,
they shall obtain the retribution of being perfectly endowed with every mark of physical excellence.
This applies even to the Bodhisattva Candraprabha, who likewise recites and upholds the Mahākaruṇā-hṛdaya Dhāraṇī.
He spoke this great divine mantra for the sake of all practitioners,
and by means of this dhāraṇī-mantra, he protected them.
He then uttered the mantra as follows:
1. Shen-di-du-su-zha-ā-yue-mi-di-wu-du-zha; 2. Shen-qi-zha-bo-lai-di-zha-ye-mi-ruo-zha-wu-du-zha; 3. Jue-lo-di-zha-qi-mo-zha; 4. Svāhā. Recite this mantra five times.
Take threads of five colors to fashion a mantra-cord;
bind this cord upon the site of pain.
This is what was taught by the Buddhas of the past, as numerous as the sands of forty Ganges Rivers.
I shall now also speak it,
for the sake of providing protection for all practitioners and for the removal of all obstacles and difficulties.
For the purpose of eliminating all evil illnesses and pains,
for the purpose of accomplishing all wholesome dharmas,
and for the purpose of remaining far removed from all fears.
If there be anyone who slanders this mantra, they are thereby slandering those Buddhas.
(48) *Pure Adornment* [Chapter] 48.
